method: Offline reviewer exact passage and embedded source dialogs; no external retrieval or payout action.

claim.text: The [Terms of Use, Disclaimer of Website](https://vast.ai/terms) include disclaimers for third-party products or services offered through the website. The [Miscellaneous section](https://vast.ai/terms) limits responsibility for delays or failures caused by circumstances beyond Vast's reasonable control. The [Limitations of Liability section](https://vast.ai/terms) notes that some exclusions may not apply under certain state laws.
